About this item

  • Find Your Perfect Fit: The Steve Madden Women's MOMENTUM are designed for a true-to-size fit. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up a half size for a customized, comfortable feel that moves with you.
  • Stylish Design: These women's sneakers include a round toe shape and velcro straps closure.
  • Effortless Elevation: Designed with a 1 inch heel, the MOMENTUM sneaker is the perfect style to wear for a casual and bold look.
  • Premium Craftsmanship: Made with a leather and suede upper, and a synthetic lining and sole, this high-quality, fashion-forward design features a refined silhouette that is made to elevate your style.
  • Care Tip: Blot spills immediately with a dry cloth without rubbing to keep from leaving water stains. Use a special brush to gently brush away dry dirt in one direction. For tough marks, use a suede eraser. Stay away from water, rain, and strong cleaners; utilize a professional to clean tough stains.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
The Perfect Travel Sneaker
I bought these sneakers for my San Francisco trip and they quickly became my go-to shoes. I walked in them every single day for four days, including through the airport, and my feet never hurt once! That says a lot because we did a ton of walking. They fit true to size, and they’re perfect for anyone with narrow feet. The gold color is so cute and surprisingly versatile — they matched every outfit I packed and made even casual looks feel a little more put together. They’re stylish, comfortable, and travel-approved. I would definitely buy these again!

About this Item

  • Find Your Perfect Fit: The Steve Madden Women's MOMENTUM are designed for a true-to-size fit. If you're between sizes, we recommend sizing up a half size for a customized, comfortable feel that moves with you.
  • Stylish Design: These women's sneakers include a round toe shape and velcro straps closure.
  • Effortless Elevation: Designed with a 1 inch heel, the MOMENTUM sneaker is the perfect style to wear for a casual and bold look.
  • Premium Craftsmanship: Made with a leather and suede upper, and a synthetic lining and sole, this high-quality, fashion-forward design features a refined silhouette that is made to elevate your style.
  • Care Tip: Blot spills immediately with a dry cloth without rubbing to keep from leaving water stains. Use a special brush to gently brush away dry dirt in one direction. For tough marks, use a suede eraser. Stay away from water, rain, and strong cleaners; utilize a professional to clean tough stains.

Product Description

Introducing the Women's MOMENTUM sneaker, a dynamic and essential shoe that will set you apart from the competition. Exclusively from Steve Madden.
